summary.text: Tracey Miller Karcher is the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Shane Klakken.

In a Ballotpedia survey, her responses cited work as a pastor, caregiver and small-business owner and campaign messages centered on the 1972 Montana Constitution, water and land, and family farms and ranches.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Tracey Miller Karcher said she lives in the Hilger area, about 28 miles north of Lewistown.

The response listed her experience as including work as a curative title researcher, animal husbandry and horse farm management, director of a crisis assistance ministry, United Methodist pastoral ministry, and full-time caregiver.
It also said she previously owned and operated The Livingston Bug Company, Thunder Ridge Riding Center, The Family Sleuth and the Sand Springs General Store & Cafe.

Her listed campaign messages were "People Over Party," representation based on lived experience, protecting the 1972 Constitution, safeguarding water and land, protecting family farms and ranches, and responsible business growth.
